name: logscope
title_zh: 多节点日志包先按流水号串起来再找慢请求
tagline_zh: 接口报错时最烦的是日志散在七八台机器上，对时间戳对到眼花。它把已导入的日志包按流水号自动串成一条链路，异常。
tagline_en: When an API breaks, logs are scattered across nodes and lining up timestamps is agony. It stitches imported.
desc_en: 使用本机 LogScope 的只读工具分析已导入的多节点日志包。适用于接口异常、慢请求和流水号排查；分析规则由 LogScope 页面维护。
why_zh: 只读调用本机 LogScope，不改数据不写库；匹配规则由页面维护，改判定条件不用重新打包技能。
why_en: Read-only calls to local LogScope: no writes, no schema changes. Matching rules live in the UI, so you retune logic without.
limit_zh: 日志必须先导入本机 LogScope 才能查，直接丢原始文件它读不了；只覆盖接口异常、慢请求、流水号三类排查。
limit_en: Logs must already be imported into local LogScope; raw files won't work. Covers only API errors, slow requests, and serial-number tracing — no.
title_en: Trace multi-node log bundles by serial number, then find.
